<style>
/* DEFAULT CSS */
span.elementor-icon-list-icon svg {
    margin: 0 !important;
}
span.elementor-icon-list-text {
    padding: 0 !important;
}

.txt-inline .dynamic-wrapper {
    display: inline !important;
}
.txt-inline span.dynamic-text {
    display:inline !important;
}

.dynamic-text {
    white-space: break-spaces;
}
@media (max-width:767.98px){
    .txt-inline .dynamic-wrapper {
    display: inline-block !important;
}

.txt-inline span.dynamic-text {
    display:inline-block !important;
}
}




/*=== Button ===*/
.mybtn .elementor-button {
    transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
    position: relative !important;
}

.mybtn .elementor-button-text {
    position: relative !important;
    display: inline-block !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
}

.mybtn .elementor-button:hover .elementor-button-text {
    animation: slideTextUp 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) forwards !important;
}

.mybtn .elementor-button .elementor-button-icon svg{
    font-size: 20px;
}

@keyframes slideTextUp {
    0% {
        transform: translateY(0);
        opacity: 1;
    }
    50% {
        transform: translateY(-100%);
        opacity: 0;
    }
    51% {
        transform: translateY(100%);
        opacity: 0;
    }
    100% {
        transform: translateY(0);
        opacity: 1;
    }
}




/*=== Teachers ===*/
.teachers-profile:hover .teachers-info {
    opacity: 1;
}

.teachers-info {
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.17, 0.79, 0.98, 0.94);
}


/*=== FAQ ===*/
.myfaq .elementskit-accordion {
    counter-reset: accordion-counter;
}
.myfaq .elementskit-card {
    counter-increment: accordion-counter;
}
.myfaq .ekit-accordion-title::before {
    content: "0" counter(accordion-counter);
    background: #FFFFFF;
    border: 1px solid #E5E8EC;
    box-shadow: 4px 6px 16px rgba(3, 31, 66, 0.08);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 5px 5px;
    font-size: 16px;
    font-family: inherit;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 24px;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    vertical-align: middle;
    margin-right: 24px;
    width: 32px;
    display: inline-flex
;
    height: 32px;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
}



.myfaq .ekit-accordion--toggler[aria-expanded="true"] {
    padding-bottom: 12px ! IMPORTANT;
}

.myfaq span.ekit-accordion-title {
    display: flex !important
;
